pick.name: Gemma 4 E2B / E4B (Q4)
pick.what: Google open-weight multimodal small models, 128K context, audio on E2B/E4B
pick.why: Best capability per RAM at 2-4B effective params; runs in llama.cpp/Ollama/LiteRT-LM/llama.rn
pick.maintained: Gemma 4 released 2026-04-02 per secondary sources; docs list E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B-A4B, 31B
pick.license: Apache-2.0 (Google Gemma docs legal link "Gemma 4 license" resolves to Apache License 2.0)

alts.name: gpt-oss-20b (OpenAI, MoE)
alts.why: Strong reasoning, MoE keeps active params small; needs ~16GB RAM (unverified)
alts.free_limits: Also free on Groq (30 RPM, 1K RPD)

alts.name: Qwen3.x small models
alts.what: Qwen3.8 family supported by Unsloth; permissive small models

decision: Gemma 4 E4B Q4 is the default for local features; step up to gpt-oss-20b for reasoning if RAM allows. Local models are for privacy/offline, not quality - keep Claude for hard tasks.
details: Verify Gemma 4 licence text (secondary sources: Apache-2.0 since 2026-04-02); real CPU tokens/sec unmeasured.
